review.title: Review before pasting
review.someFailed: {{count}} step failed, the text before it is shown
review.someFailed_other: {{count}} steps failed, the text before them is shown
review.keysHint: Y or Enter to paste · N or Esc to discard

settings.title: Rewrite chain
settings.description: After cleanup, run your dictation through your own rewrite steps, then review the result before it is pasted.
settings.enabledDescription: Runs after Dictation Cleanup on normal dictations. Assistant commands, selection edits and translations are left alone.
settings.requireApprovalDescription: Shows a translucent card with the original and the rewrite. Y or Enter pastes, N or Esc discards (the dictation stays in History).
settings.cleanupOffHint: Dictation Cleanup is off, so the steps start from the raw transcript.
settings.stepsDescription: Steps run top to bottom; each one gets the previous step's output. Each step has its own model.
settings.noSteps: No steps yet. Add one to start your chain.
settings.noRunnableSteps: The chain is on, but no step is ready to run, so dictations paste as before.
settings.stepPromptHelp: Tell the model what to do with the text. The text is sent separately and treated as content, never as instructions.
